title: 10 Day Namibia and Botswana Safari: Etosha, Okavango River and Chobe
rank_math_title: Namibia and Botswana Safari: 10 Days, Etosha to Chobe
rank_math_desc: Namibia and Botswana safari for 10 days: Etosha game drives, the Okavango River and Zambezi region, then three nights on the Chobe River.
post_content: This Namibia and Botswana safari follows the classic overland route from Etosha to Chobe.
overview:
This Namibia and Botswana safari follows the classic overland route from Etosha to Chobe. Start with two nights of game drives around the waterholes of Etosha National Park, then head east along the Okavango River through the green Zambezi region, with boat trips and game drives in Mahango and Bwabwata. Cross into Botswana for three nights on the Chobe River in Kasane, among some of Africa's biggest elephant herds. It suits travellers who want two countries and very different landscapes in one trip, and Victoria Falls is only an hour from the finish.

Price: from USD 3,030 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Two nights in Etosha National Park
Okavango River boat trips and Mahango game drives
Three nights on the Chobe River in Botswana

faq.q: How much does this Namibia and Botswana safari cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 3,030 per adult sharing, based on low-season rates. Prices rise from July to October; we confirm the price for your dates when you enquire.

faq.q: Is it a lot of driving?
faq.a: Some days have five to six hours on the road, broken by game viewing and stops. The route avoids backtracking from Windhoek to Kasane.

faq.q: Can we add Victoria Falls or the Okavango Delta?
faq.a: Yes. Victoria Falls is an hour from Kasane, and a fly-in Delta camp can be added from Kasane or Maun.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Windhoek to Etosha
itinerary.content: Collection in Windhoek and drive north to the eastern side of Etosha. Dinner and overnight at Mokuti Etosha Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Etosha National Park
itinerary.content: Full day of game drives between Etosha's waterholes for elephants, lions, rhinos and plains game. Dinner and overnight at Mokuti Etosha Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Etosha to the Okavango River
itinerary.content: Drive to Rundu on the Okavango River. Sunset on the river. Dinner and overnight at Hakusembe River Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: To Divundu and Mahango
itinerary.content: Drive east along the river to Divundu. Afternoon game drive in the Mahango core area of Bwabwata National Park. Dinner and overnight at Mahangu Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Okavango River
itinerary.content: Morning boat trip for birds, hippos and crocodiles, with a visit to Popa Falls. Dinner and overnight at Mahangu Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Zambezi region
itinerary.content: Drive into the Zambezi region to the Kwando River. Afternoon boat trip. Dinner and overnight at Namushasha River Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Into Botswana
itinerary.content: Cross at Ngoma into Botswana, with game viewing through Chobe National Park to Kasane. Dinner and overnight at Chobe Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Chobe National Park
itinerary.content: Morning game drive and afternoon boat safari on the Chobe River. Dinner and overnight at Chobe Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Chobe National Park
itinerary.content: Another day of game drives and boat trips. Dinner and overnight at Chobe Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.content: Transfer to Kasane airport, or continue to Victoria Falls.

includes: Private 4x4 safari vehicle with English-speaking guide (days 1 to 7)
Shared game drives and boat safaris at Chobe Safari Lodge
Park entry fees in Etosha (N$280 per adult per day from April 2026), Bwabwata and Chobe
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
Flights to Windhoek and from Kasane
